title: Gate Sovereign
summary: World boss of the invasion · level 100 · its health is set by the awakened who fight it.

blocks.text: Gate Sovereign is the world boss of the Invasion event: "The gate opens for its master." It comes at every rank, once the waves of monsters are down. It is a giant, about ten times as tall as an awakened, and the bestiary of the game gives it a section of its own.
blocks.html: Gate Sovereign is the world boss of the Invasion event: "The gate opens for its master." It comes at every rank, once the waves of monsters are down. It is a giant, about ten times as tall as an awakened, and the bestiary of the game gives it a section of its own.

blocks.text: Invasion event: an enormous gate opens over the city and, after the waves of monsters, it comes down out of it as a bolt of lightning Sometimes on every server at once: then it comes alone, with one health bar for all the servers
blocks.html:
• Invasion event: an enormous gate opens over the city and, after the waves of monsters, it comes down out of it as a bolt of lightning
  • Sometimes on every server at once: then it comes alone, with one health bar for all the servers

blocks.text: These are its own values. In an invasion it hits 15% harder and its health is set by the fight (below).
blocks.html: These are its own values. In an invasion it hits 15% harder and its health is set by the fight (below).

blocks.text: Melee Cone Shockwave Barrage Quake Rift Rend Abyss Gate
Rift Rend and Abyss Gate are its two signature attacks: each one can hit you twice.
blocks.html: Rift Rend and Abyss Gate are its two signature attacks: each one can hit you twice.

blocks.text: Shield : at 66% and 33% of its health it is shielded for 3 s and 4 monsters drop out of the gate (more with more awakened, 10 at most; none when it is on every server) Health : set by the strength of the awakened who fight it, for a fight of about 7 minutes; it grows when more awakened come or when it falls too fast (what was taken stays taken), it shrinks a little when the fight drags Time limit : 15 minutes from the start of the invasion; still standing then, the gate closes and nobody is rewarded
blocks.html:
• Shield: at 66% and 33% of its health it is shielded for 3 s and 4 monsters drop out of the gate (more with more awakened, 10 at most; none when it is on every server)
  • Health: set by the strength of the awakened who fight it, for a fight of about 7 minutes; it grows when more awakened come or when it falls too fast (what was taken stays taken), it shrinks a little when the fight drags
  • Time limit: 15 minutes from the start of the invasion; still standing then, the gate closes and nobody is rewarded

blocks.text: Once it falls, every awakened on the damage board (any damage counts) is rewarded by his place: shards (the clear shards of the rank's dungeon ×8, plus up to ×20 more for his share of the damage; places 1 to 3 ×2, ×1.6 and ×1.3), an item of the rank's grade (one grade higher for the first place), a 20-minute ×2 XP and shards boost, an XP token and a shard token. Places 1 to 3 also get an anomaly summon and 2 luck tokens.

Places 1 to 3 also get an anomaly summon and 2 luck tokens.

blocks.text: Each rewarded awakened may also win a special edition weapon (SP and EX), made for a weapon style of his class first: invasion special editions .
